findings.title: Drawn ads and drawn Marketing pictures put a logo box in the layout but never send the logo
findings.detail: adDraft plans the logo's place whenever the brand has a logo (logo: i.brand?.logo ? {w:3,h:1}), and adPlanDraft turns it into an object item captioned "The brand's logo, small and crisp". The logo image never reaches the model. src/server/marketing.ts now leaves the logo reference out when drawn (the refs line has `!onTop && !drawn && ... brand.logo`). src/server/ads.ts visualRequest sends only the product photo, and none at all for MOSS-Image. So every drawn ad or poster asks MOSS-Image, Ideogram 4.5 or FLUX.3 to make up a logo in the brand's logo place. Verified with a probe: visualRequest(..., 'flux-3', drawn=true) gives inputs.images = [product photo] only, and the layout items are object:'Candle…' | object:"The brand's logo, small and crisp" | text:Glow | text:Warm nights | text:Shop. The compiled FLUX.3 prompt names <obj_2> The brand's logo. moss-image gets the same box with no inputs at all. Fix options: drop the logo item for models that can't take references (or draw the brand name as text there), and pass brand.logo as a reference to models that take several images (FLUX.3 maxImages 10, Ideogram reference_image_urls). The brief listed the logo area as an object item, but without the real logo it becomes an invented mark on the brand's ad.
findings.verified: temporary probe test running visualRequest and planGeneration (removed afterwards)

findings.title: Ideogram 4.5 drawn ads edit the product photo, which the report and UI notes say doesn't happen
findings.detail: `hero = drawn && !supportsOp(model,'edit') ? undefined : product.images[0]`. Ideogram 4.5 supports edit, so a drawn ad on Ideogram runs op=edit on ideogram/v4.5/edit. buildPayload then sets both image_url (the image to edit) and reference_image_urls to the product photo. The drawn ad is therefore an edit of the product photo. Its output is portrait_4_3 (3:4, since the 4:5 map value is portrait_4_3), and it is letterboxed in the 4:5 'drawn' format. This contradicts the implementer's 'left' note (MOSS-Image / Ideogram 4.5 drawn runs are text-to-image), and the option notes imply only FLUX.3 keeps the photo. The same applies in Marketing, where Ideogram gets op edit with the product photo. Decide which behaviour is intended, then align the code, the notes and the tests: none of the tests covers drawn + Ideogram + product.
findings.verified: probe: ideogram-4-5 drawn → op 'edit', aspect 4:5, layout format ideogram; payload.ts L362-363 maps images to both image_url and reference_image_urls

findings.title: An Assist layout's own aspect is sent as the run's aspect ratio without checking that the model offers it
findings.detail: aspectRatio: j.aspect_ratio ?? layout?.aspect. parseLayout derives the aspect from the pixel width/height, and the skill only asks for multiples of 16. A draft of 896×1152 gives '7:9', which planGeneration passes through unchanged for flux-3 (whose fal aspect_ratio enum has no 7:9) and for ideogram-4-5 (whose image_size map has no 7:9). The job then fails at the provider or quietly falls back to a square. Snap to the nearest ratio the model lists, or leave aspect unset when the ratio isn't listed. Assist jobs also don't cap the number of layout items (Canvas caps them at 64).
findings.verified: probe: parseLayout({width:896,height:1152,...}).draft.aspect === '7:9'; planGeneration for flux-3 / ideogram-4-5 kept aspectRatio '7:9'

findings.title: The keep-clear layout is always planned as a 4:5 overlay, whatever layout the creative uses
findings.detail: For a box-reading visual model (FLUX.3) the keep-clear draft is adDraft({layout:'overlay', ratio: 4:5}). The creative is then shown in its own layout (r.layout: band, frame, panel…) and cropped to 1:1 and 9:16, so the product may not be kept out of the words' space there. The implementer acknowledged this in 'left'. Fine as a first step, but the feature only fully works for the 4:5 overlay.

fix.finalSummary: Committed b1ddfc90 on o/n7-8-layouts-everywhere. Open engine: Canvas Layout node, Marketing and Ads 'Words drawn by the model' on MOSS-Image (from words alone; the brand name is drawn where the logo would go, so no logo is made up), Plan layout and the layout-poster skill. All are built and tested in unit tests and the earlier browser checks. How well the model draws needs a GPU. Cloud engine: MOSS-Image on fal (words only), Ideogram 4.5 and FLUX.3 (edit the product photo and now get the brand's real logo for its box). Built and tested at the request and plan level; real output needs a fal key. Assist and MCP layouts now run in a shape the model lists, with at most 64 boxes. Public sign-up is unchanged from the review: /api/layout/plan answers 403 own-gpu-tool to guests and accounts. Drawn runs add only the brand kit's logo as an input, which is the owner's own kit already used by Marketing's non-drawn partner runs. Accounts can't reach Ads or Marketing cloud runs. No new file-reading path for accounts.
left: How well MOSS-Image, Ideogram 4.5 and FLUX.3 draw the copy and place the logo is unverified (no GPU, no fal key).
Ideogram 4.5 maps 4:5 to portrait_4_3 (3:4), so a drawn Ideogram ad is laid out at 4:5 but rendered at 3:4 and letterboxed. A later fix could pick an aspect Ideogram maps exactly.
The keep-clear layout is planned only for the 4:5 overlay (see rejected).
